entities.name: Andrzej Marek Chołdzyński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrzej Marek Chołdzyński is a Polish architect. He is the designer of Plac Wilsona metro station in Warsaw, the central part of the second Warsaw metro line and the headquarters of the Warsaw Stock Exchange in Warsaw, among others. He was nominated for the European Union Prize for Contemporary Architecture in 2001.
